Players may use the pyre logs, along with a set of shade remains (Loar, Phrin, Riyl or Asyn), on one of the numerous funeral pyres located to the south and to the west of Mort'ton's centre. The pyre can then be lit, which releases the shade and rewards Firemaking and Prayer experience, as well as some coins or a key which will appear on the nearby stone stand. The type of key rewarded solely depends on the type of remains that are cremated, and do not depend on the logs used.
After the Legacy of Seergaze quest, these may also be used to cremate vyre corpses in the Columbarium under Paterdomus temple.
